verdict.rationale: UKVI's own public pages offer an online service to check visa processing time that 'will tell you when you can expect a decision' (docs-20, supp-3). The eVisa service lets you access your online immigration status once granted (docs-2). Neither is documented as a live lookup of a pending application's or case's status, so support for the story is glancing. Missing for 10: a documented case or application status tracker for pending filings, status lookup for founder-route applications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
